title: Small Language Model Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Compact models for laptops, edge devices, and offline learning — selection, compression, and deployment records. The Small Language Model Database is the practical guide to AI that fits in a pocket: models from ~100M to ~8B parameters that run on laptops, phones, and edge devices without a data center. Records cover which small models exist, how they were compressed (quantization, distillation, pruning), what hardware they run on, measured speed and quality, and deployment recipes for offline use. Small models trade raw capability for ownership: they run anywhere, cost almost nothing, and never send your data away.

title: Small Language Model Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Size math: parameters P at b bits need P*b/8 bytes (7B params at 16-bit = 14 GB; at 4-bit ~3.5 GB). Quantization: map float weights to int4/int8 with per-group scales; quality loss grows as groups shrink. Distillation: train small student on large teacher outputs; loss = alpha*CE(student, labels) + (1-alpha)*KL(student||teacher). Pruning: remove low-magnitude weights or whole structures, then fine-tune. KV-cache: at context n, cache ~ 2*n*layers*d_model bytes at fp16 — long context on small RAM needs cache quantization or sliding windows. Routing insight: small models handle easy queries; route hard ones up (see AI Model Routing).

body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Tests: size-math test (estimates match measured installs within 10%); checksum test (tampered files rejected); quality-delta test (reported deltas reproduce on the eval subset); hardware test (tokens/sec measured on the reference device, not extrapolated). Limitations: per-device variance is real; new model releases obsolete picks; license terms change — recheck before deploying. Catalog entries carry last-verified dates.

demo.title: Verification: calibration error (ECE)
demo.code: const pairs=[[0.9,1],[0.9,1],[0.9,0],[0.6,1],[0.6,0],[0.6,0]];const bins={};pairs.forEach(([c,ok])=>{const b=Math.round(c*10)/10;(bins[b]=bins[b]||{n:0,c:0,conf:0});bins[b].n++;bins[b].c+=ok;bins[b].conf+=c;});let ece=0;for(const b in bins){const B=bins[b];ece+=Math.abs(B.c/B.n-B.conf/B.n)*(B.n/pairs.length);}J({ece:+ece.toFixed(3)});assert(ece>0&&ece<1,'ece');
